incident.evidence_source: Filtered metadata supplied by parent task; no target URLs, page content, accounts, credentials, saved prompts or live browser accessed by repair.
incident.root_cause: Tool schema allowed an omitted selector, while the runtime type required one and dispatch unconditionally called locator.press. The locator was only initialized when the operation contained a selector.
incident.reproduction: Real local Chromium, native SQLite and loopback model protocol fixture reproduced the identical undefined.press error against unchanged 0.6.10 source.

contracts.selectorless_press: Exactly one page.keyboard.press call uses the current page focus; no element selection or focus change by the adapter.
contracts.selected_press: Exactly one locator.press call on the existing live unique visible locator; hidden copies are excluded and multiple visible matches remain rejected.
contracts.invalid_supplied_selector: Empty, null, undefined, missing, hidden, ambiguous or malformed supplied selectors never fall back to page keyboard. An absent selector property is the page-keyboard contract.
contracts.scope_and_cancellation: Existing checks retained, with an additional check immediately before dispatch.
contracts.dispatched_action_failure: Terminal action_or_after; retryable false; uncertain dispatch never reports action_performed:false; no fallback or automatic replay.
contracts.business_outcome: Successful key dispatch is separate from the expected-state assertion.
contracts.episode_reset: Successful click/fill/select/press/assert requires a nonempty selector to restore the selector correction allowance.

covers: selectorless Escape emits exactly one trusted keydown and keyup at the current focus
selected Escape targets one visible input despite another focus and a hidden duplicate
separate UI assertion verifies actual native dialog closure
missing, hidden, ambiguous, malformed and explicitly invalid supplied selectors dispatch no keys
unsupported keys remain rejected without dispatch
cancellation before dispatch, during selected-control wait and after real key dispatch
target scope rejection before page keyboard dispatch
injected failures after real page and locator dispatch are terminal and never replayed by scheduler
real Enter form submission followed by navigation timeout submits once and terminates
selectorless press does not replenish correction budget, selected press still resolves the episode
existing visible uniqueness, selector corrections, actionability, provider denial and no-replay contracts
